as_read: Mixed: four small placebo-controlled trials at the label's 40 mg report higher BMD gain, and one larger trial of 40 mg in milk found no significant effect; no abstract names a primary outcome.
stop_list: Label combines MBP 40 mg with 600 mg calcium and 400 IU vitamin D; trials give MBP without them.
No abstract names a primary outcome, so full texts would settle whether BMD was declared primary. PMIDs 17048062 and 16133638 first.
12005077 and 11388472 report the same sample size (33) and duration; the abstracts don't say whether they share participants.
clinician_items: 17482742: products containing MBP are labelled as containing milk because MBP has not been shown free of milk allergens.
stored_rating_note: Stored positive_weak cites only 17048062. It leaves out the null 19296044 and three further positive trials.
